Izvi ndizvo zvinotaura Jehovha kuvanhu veJudha neJerusarema:
imi varume veJudha nemi vanhu veJerusarema,
kuti kutsamwa kwangu kurege kukubudirai kukapisa somoto,
"Zivisai munyika yaJudha uye muparidze muJerusarema muchiti:
Nokuti ndiri kuuyisa njodzi inobva kumusoro,
Ipapo ndakati, "Haiwa, Ishe Jehovha, makanyengera kwazvo vanhu ava neJerusarema muchiti, 'Muchava norugare,' nyamba munondo uri pahuro dzedu."
Panguva iyoyo vanhu ava neJerusarema vachaudzwa kuti, "Mhepo inopisa inobva kunzvimbo dzakakwirira dzisina miti mugwenga inovhuvhuta yakananga vanhu vangu, asi isingapepeti kana kunatsa;
mhepo ine simba kwazvo kudarika iyoyo ichabva kwandiri. Zvino ndiwo wava mutongo wangu pamusoro pavo."
Haiwa Jerusarema, shamba zvakaipa zviri mumwoyo mako ugoponeswa.
Ucharamba uchingoviga pfungwa dzako dzakaipa kusvikira riini?
'Hondo ichakukombai iri kuuya ichibva kunyika iri kure,
Hana yangu inorova mukati mangu, handinganyarari.
Munguva shoma shoma, matende angu aparadzwa,
Ndicharamba ndichiona mureza wehondo kusvikira riniko,
uye ndichanzwa kurira kwehwamanda kusvikira riniko?
shiri dzose dzedenga dzakanga dzabhururuka dzikaenda kure.
Ndakatarira, ndokuona nyika yaibereka zvibereko yava gwenga;
maguta ayo ose ava matongo pamberi paJehovha,
nokuti ndini ndazvitaura uye handingaregi kuzviita,
Paanonzwa kutinhira kwavatasvi vamabhiza nokwavawemburi vouta,
Ndiri kunzwa kuchema sekwomukadzi anorwadziwa pakusununguka,
